name: Creeper
attack: Explosion (up to 49 damage at point blank)
drops: Gunpowder (0-2), Music Disc (if killed by a skeleton arrow)
behavior: Silently approaches players and hisses for 1.5s before detonating. Afraid of Cats and Ocelots!

name: Enderman
behavior: Teleports when attacked or when looked in the eyes. Damaged by water and rain. Wear a Carved Pumpkin to look safely.

name: Warden
attack: 30 melee damage (Normal), Sonic Boom ranged attack (15 damage ignoring armor/shields)
behavior: Completely blind; navigates via sound and vibrations. Can sniff out hiding players within 49 blocks. Do NOT fight unless prepared!

name: Ender Dragon
attack: Dragon Breath, Perching shockwave, Melee charge
behavior: Ruler of the End. Heals constantly from End Crystals atop obsidian towers. Shoot crystals with arrows first.

name: Wither
attack: Wither Skulls, Wither Effect II damage over time
drops: Nether Star (1) — Used to craft Beacons
behavior: Summoned with 4 Soul Sand (T-shape) and 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls. Becomes immune to arrows at 50% health.

name: Blaze
attack: Tri-burst fireballs (5 damage + burn over time)
drops: Blaze Rod (0-1) — Essential for Eyes of Ender and Brewing Stands
behavior: Spawns from monster spawners inside Nether Fortresses. Hover and fly. Highly vulnerable to snowballs (3 damage per hit).

name: Iron Golem
behavior: Spawns in villages to protect villagers. Can be created with 4 Iron Blocks and 1 Carved Pumpkin.
